evidence.excerpt: Several headline scope claims are overstated relative to the tested regime. The Abstract and Conclusion say ExTernD can approach “any quantization level,” “any target accuracy,” and make “ternary LLMs viable,” while the Results cover only matrices from three models up to 4B scale and one full perplexity run on Qwen3.5-4B. Sec. 5 correctly notes that behavior above 4B, downstream benchmarks, long-context checks, and fused kernels are untested, but the Abstract and Conclusion do not carry these qualifications.
